# D01 design: Design system in React

Covers NFR23 (keyboard, focus, contrast, labels), NFR24 (375, 768 and 1280 px), NFR25 (foundations only: no video player in D01) and NFR27 (no colour-only meaning).

Three surfaces:

1. Component gallery at `/dev/components`.
2. Shared UI library in `web/src/components/ui/`.
3. Theme mechanism.

## Rules for the whole chunk

- Use colours, radii, spacing and fonts only through `var(--token)` in CSS, or through the Tailwind utilities that `globals.css` maps to tokens (`bg-surface`, `text-ink`, `border-line`, `rounded-md` and so on).
- Tailwind spacing steps match the space tokens: 1 = `space-1`, 2 = `space-2`, 3 = `space-3`, 4 = `space-4`, 6 = `space-6`, 8 = `space-8`, 12 = `space-12`. Use only these steps. Do not use 5, 7, 10 or arbitrary `[..px]` values.
- Text styles come from the design-system classes: `heading-1`, `heading-2`, `body`, `body-lg`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data` and `eyebrow`. Use `eyebrow` instead of `overline`, because Tailwind's `overline` utility clashes with it. Never set font sizes with Tailwind.
- Icons are Lucide, used through `iconProps`: stroke 1.5, `aria-hidden`. The bundle CSS sets their size. Every icon sits next to a word. The only icon-only controls are `IconButton`s, and each one has an `aria-label`.
- The focus ring comes from the bundle's `:focus-visible` rule in `components.css` (components layer): 2px solid `focus`, 2px offset. Never remove it without drawing a replacement, as PlayerCard does below.
- Motion: hover and toggle transitions are 150ms ease-out. Nothing counts up. `globals.css` already handles `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Copy: sentence case, SA/British spelling, football words, no exclamation marks, no emoji.

### CSS "Additions (not in bundle.css)" block, end of `components.css`

Every value in this block is a `var()` token, or a dimension that the design system itself fixes (the 44px touch target, the 18px icon size from `.wl-btn svg`, the Cover geometry from `Cover/preview.html`). Type comes from the type classes in markup, never from font sizes in CSS. The only accepted font-size exceptions are the 88px Cover wordmark and the 3.2-unit dot label; `tests/unit/design-system.test.ts` allows exactly those.

| Rule | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-cover` | `position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface)`. Below 768px: no fixed height. From 768px: `height: 288px`. |
| `.wl-cover__art` | Hidden below 1024px. From 1024px: `position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 480px; height: 288px; overflow: hidden`. At 768px the art would sit under the 88px wordmark, which is why it starts at 1024px, not 768px. Scope the block classes under it: `.wl-cover__art .pitch { fill: var(--pitch) }`, plus `.turf`, `.flood` (`--floodlight`), `.deep` (`--ink`), `.home`, `.chalk` (`fill: none; stroke: var(--chalk); stroke-width: 1.5`), `.blk { rx: var(--radius-lg) }` and `.sm { rx: var(--radius-sm) }`. |
| `.wl-cover__words` | Below 768px: static, `padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-4) var(--space-6)`. From 768px: `position: absolute; left: var(--space-8); bottom: var(--space-8); max-width: 440px`. |
| `.wl-cover__name` | Markup adds `display-xl` (56px). CSS: `margin: 0; color: var(--ink)`. From 768px: `font-size: 88px; line-height: .92` (accepted exception, from `Cover/preview.html`). |
| `.wl-cover__tag` | Markup adds `body` (15/22; the preview's 14/20 is off the type scale). CSS: `margin: var(--space-2) 0 0; color: var(--ink-muted)` (the preview's 2px left nudge is off the 4px grid, so it is dropped). |
| `@media (max-width: 767px)` `.wl-iconbtn` | `width: 44px; height: 44px`. |
| `@media (max-width: 767px)` `.wl-event` | `grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto`. Time: column 1, row 1, `align-self: start`. `.wl-event__what`: columns 2 to -1, row 1. 3rd child (meter or chip): columns 1 to 3, row 2, `justify-self: start`. 4th child (actions or spacer): column 3, row 2, `justify-self: end`. Line 1 reads time, type and who. Line 2 reads confidence on the left and actions on the right. |
| `.wl-player__stats` | `flex-wrap: wrap; row-gap: var(--space-3)`. |
| `.wl-menu` | The PlayerCard menu. The design system has no menu component, so it is specified here from tokens. `position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + var(--space-1)); z-index: 20; min-width: calc(var(--space-12) * 4); padding: var(--space-1); background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop)`. |
| `.wl-menu__item` | `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 var(--space-3); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none`. Markup adds `body` for the type. `:hover` and `:focus-visible` get `background: var(--surface-sunken)`. Height is 44px below 768px. |
| `.wl-pitch .dot-home` | `fill: var(--home); stroke: var(--chalk); stroke-width: .6`. |
| `.wl-pitch .dot-away` | `fill: var(--chalk); stroke: var(--away); stroke-width: .8`. |
| `.wl-pitch .dot-label` | `fill: var(--chalk); font: 600 3.2px var(--font-display)`. The size is in SVG user units. |

Why the dots have a chalk halo: light `home` and `away` on light `turf` are about 1:1, which fails the 3:1 rule for graphics. The chalk stroke on home and the chalk fill on away fix this. Home is a dark centre and away a light centre, so the two sides differ in greyscale too.

## Surface 1: component gallery, `/dev/components`

**Who, where, job.** Wideline staff (`platform_admin`), on desktop mostly, plus phone and tablet for checks. The page has one job: check every component, in every variant, in both themes, before a change ships. Playwright baselines and axe run against it.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(DEV_ROLES)` on the server. The proxy matcher `/dev/:path*` sends signed-out visitors to `/login?next=/dev/components`.

### Page structure (DOM order = visual order = tab order)

1. `<main id="main">`, with `px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8` (`space-4`, `space-6`, `space-8`), `pt-6 md:pt-8`, `pb-12`.
2. Header, inside the gutters:
   - h1 `heading-1`: **Components**
   - Intro, `body text-ink-muted max-w-prose mt-2`: **Every Wideline component in every variant. The light and dark sections below are forced with ThemeScope; the rest of this page follows your system setting. Sample data only.**
   - `<nav aria-label="On this page">`, `mt-4 wl-row`: a `caption text-ink-muted` "On this page:", then two text links in `text-pitch underline`: **Light theme** (`#light-theme`) and **Dark theme** (`#dark-theme`).
3. `<ThemeScope theme="light">` band, then `<ThemeScope theme="dark">` band.
   - Each band is full-bleed: it breaks out of the main gutters with `-mx-4 md:-mx-6 lg:-mx-8` and puts the same gutters back inside. Vertical padding is `py-8 md:py-12`. The bands follow each other with no gap, so the theme change reads as a hard edge.
   - The bands always stack. They are never side by side, because each band must show the real responsive layout at the viewport width.

### Inside a band: `<section id="{theme}-theme" data-gallery-theme="{theme}" aria-labelledby="{theme}-theme-heading">`

- h2 `heading-2` `id="{theme}-theme-heading"`: **Light theme** / **Dark theme**.
- Block grid, `mt-6 grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-12 lg:gap-x-6`. Each block is `<div data-component="Name" id="{theme}-{name-kebab}">` with:
  - an h3 `body-strong`;
  - a one-line rule in `caption text-ink-muted mt-1`;
  - content at `mt-4`.
- Sub-groups inside a block are labelled with `<p class="eyebrow text-ink-muted">`, not headings. A group's content starts at `mt-2`, and groups are spaced `space-y-4`.
- Blocks have no card wrapper. Components that are cards bring their own.

| # | `data-component` | h3 | Rule line | Span at 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Button | Button | One primary button per view. Buttons act; links navigate. | 12 |
| 2 | StatusChip | Status chip | Every chip pairs a colour with a word and an icon. Chips are never clickable. | 12 |
| 3 | ConsentBadge | Consent badge | Club staff only. Scouts never see this badge. | 6 |
| 4 | TeamMarker | Team marker | Shape and letter as well as colour. | 6 |
| 5 | ConfidenceMeter | Confidence meter | Auto-accept threshold 0.75. Never shown on public profiles. | 6 |
| 6 | ExpiryBanner | Expiry banner | Warning from 3 days left, danger under 24 hours. | 6 |
| 7 | StatTile | Stat tile | Under 3 matches, the small-sample flag shows. | 12 |
| 8 | PlayerCard | Player card | The whole card links to the profile. | 12 |
| 9 | ReviewEventRow | Review event row | Y confirms, E edits, N rejects. J and K move between rows in the review workspace. | 12 |
| 10 | PitchHeatmap | Pitch heatmap | Attacking left to right, always with a legend. | 6 |
| 11 | AveragePositionMap | Average position map | One dot per player, with the side letter. | 6 |
| 12 | Cover | Cover | Pitch geometry only. No photos. | 12 |

At 375 and 768, every block spans the full width, in this order.

### Block contents (fixtures in `fixtures.ts`)

Fixed `now` = `2025-10-22T10:00:00+02:00` (a Wednesday). The warning expiry is now + 2 days = Friday 24 Oct, 10:00. The danger expiry is now + 6 hours.

1. **Button**
   - *Variants* (`wl-row`): primary "Mark as reviewed" (icon `Check`), secondary "Upload match", ghost "Add missed event" (icon `Plus`), danger "Withdraw consent".
   - *Size and state* (`wl-row`): sm primary "Claim match", sm primary disabled "Claim match", sm secondary "Export CSV".
   - *Shortcuts* (`wl-row`): primary "Confirm" with Kbd **Y**, secondary "Edit" with Kbd **E**, danger "Reject" with Kbd **N**.
   - *Links* (`wl-row`): `ButtonLink` secondary "Back to matches" (`/lab/matches`), and ghost "View profile" (`#{theme}-player-card`).
   - *Icon buttons* (`wl-row`): default `Pencil` "Edit (E)", ok `Check` "Confirm (Y)", no `X` "Reject (N)".
   - *Full width on phones* (`wl-stack`, `max-w-md` from md): block primary "Yes, scouts can see them", then block secondary "No, keep them inside the club". Below 768px each button is full width and 48px tall. From 768px each is auto width and 40px.
   - Real screens keep one primary per view. The gallery breaks that rule only to show the variants.
2. **StatusChip**
   - *Event states*: Confirmed, Auto-accepted, Pending review, Rejected, Manual.
   - *Match states*: Draft, Uploading, Processing, Awaiting review, In review, Published, Failed.
   - *Accent*: New (tone `new`, icon `CircleDot`). It appears once per band.
3. **ConsentBadge**: Scout-visible, Club only, Requested, Withdrawn, No consent, in one `wl-row`.
4. **TeamMarker**: home "Orlando Pirates U17", away "SuperSport Academy U17" (`wl-row gap-6`).
5. **ConfidenceMeter**: a `<dl>` in a 2-column grid (`grid grid-cols-2 gap-4`). Each `dt` is in `caption text-ink-muted` and each `dd` holds the meter.
   - "Above threshold": 0.93
   - "At threshold": 0.75
   - "Below threshold": 0.68
   - "Below threshold, detail view": 0.58 with `detail`, which shows "0.58 below threshold"

   All four use threshold 0.75.
6. **ExpiryBanner** (`wl-stack`):
   - Warning: "**Footage deleted in 2 days.** Review this match before Friday 24 Oct to add missed events. Stats you confirm are kept." The date comes from `formatDeletionDate`.
   - Danger: "**Footage deleted in 6 hours.** This match has no reviewer yet. Claim it now or it will publish with auto-accepted events only."
   - *Queue row label*: `ExpiryLabel` at 2 days (warn) and at 6 hours (danger), in a `wl-row`.
7. **StatTile**, in `grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:gap-6 lg:grid-cols-4`:
   - "Goals per 90", 0.62, "Based on 7 matches · 612 min".
   - "Distance covered", 8.4, unit "km per match", "Based on 7 matches".
   - "Shots on target", 71, unit "%", 2 matches. Shows "Small sample · 2 matches".
   - Linked: "Shots per 90", 2.1, "Based on 7 matches · 612 min", href `#{theme}-stat-tile` (its own block id), so it navigates nowhere real.
8. **PlayerCard**, in `grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 md:gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3`:
   - Thabo Nkosi · Winger · U17 · Left foot · Orlando Pirates Academy. Consent `scout_visible`. Stats: 14 Matches / 0.62 Goals per 90 / 2.1 Shots per 90 / 8.4 km Distance. Shortlist href is set.
   - Sipho Dlamini · Centre-back · U17 · Right foot · former club Kaizer Chiefs Academy. Consent `club_only`. Pass 5 stats (Matches 11, Tackles per 90 3.4, Interceptions per 90 2.2, Distance 9.1 km, Headers won 61%); only the first 4 show.
   - Lebo Mokoena · Central midfielder · U15 · Both feet · SuperSport Academy. No consent prop, so this is the scout view. Stats: 6 Matches / 48 Passes per 90 / 1.3 Chances created per 90 / 10.2 km Distance.
9. **ReviewEventRow**: `<ul aria-label="Sample events">` in `max-w-xl rounded-md border border-line overflow-hidden`.
   - 31:24 "Shot on target", home, #7 Thabo Nkosi, 0.68 / 0.75, pending, current.
   - 38:02 "Goal", away, Unlinked track 22, 0.84 / 0.90, pending.
   - 41:57 "Touch", home, #4 Sipho Dlamini, note "corrected", confirmed.

   The gallery passes no handlers, so the buttons do nothing.
10. **PitchHeatmap** inside `wl-card`: the 4 × 6 grid from `PitchHeatmap/preview.html`, 7 matches. Label: "Heatmap: most time in the attacking half, left of centre". The preview's "attacking right channel" does not match its own grid: facing right, the top rows are the left flank.
11. **AveragePositionMap** inside `wl-card`, 7 matches.
    - Home: 7 at (78, 22), 4 at (30, 40), 10 at (60, 30).
    - Away: 9 at (40, 34), 5 at (85, 28), 8 at (62, 48).
    - Label: "Average positions: home players highest in the attacking half, away players spread across midfield".
    - Key under the pitch: TeamMarker home "Orlando Pirates U17" and away "SuperSport Academy U17".
12. **Cover**: `titleAs="p"`, default title and tagline, inside `rounded-md border border-line overflow-hidden`.

### Layout per width (one band; both are the same)

| | 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gutters | `space-4` | `space-6` | `space-8` |
| Blocks | single column | single column | 12-col grid, pairs 3+4, 5+6, 10+11 side by side |
| StatTile | 2 columns. A unit that does not fit wraps under the number | 2 columns | 4 in a row |
| PlayerCard | 1 column | 2 columns, 3rd card alone on row 2 | 3 columns |
| ReviewEventRow | stacked rows (Additions), 44px icon buttons | grid row, 36px buttons | grid row, list capped at `max-w-xl` |
| Pitches | full card width | full width, max 420px (bundle) | half width, max 420px |
| Cover | words only, 56px name | 288px tall, words bottom-left, 88px name, no art | 288px tall, art on the right, words bottom-left |

### States

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Signed out | The proxy redirects to `/login?next=/dev/components`. |
| Signed in, not `platform_admin` | `requirePageRole` redirects to `/forbidden`. The copy on that page names the CV Lab only. Change its body to: **Your account does not have access to this page. Ask a Wideline admin if you think you need it.** Keep the "Sign in as someone else" button. |
| Loading | None. The page is static and server-rendered from fixtures, so it needs no `loading.tsx`. |
| Error | No data fetch, so the default Next error boundary covers any error. |
| Empty, partial, long, small sample | Shown per component in the blocks above, and specified per component in Surface 2. |

### Keyboard, focus, screen readers

- Heading outline: h1 Components, then h2 Light theme, then h3 per component; then h2 Dark theme, then h3 per component.
- Landmarks: `main`, `nav "On this page"`, and two `section` regions named by their h2.
- Tab order follows DOM order:
  1. The two "On this page" links.
  2. The light band: buttons, links and icon buttons; the linked stat tile; per player card, the name link then "More actions"; the pending row's Confirm, Edit and Reject.
  3. The dark band, in the same order.
- Chips, markers, meters, banners and pitches are not focusable.
- IDs get a theme prefix (`light-…`, `dark-…`) so `aria-labelledby` and anchors stay unique.
- The danger banner uses `role="alert"`, so it is announced when the page loads, once per band. That is expected on this page only.
- Theme: the page follows the system setting. The two bands are forced to their theme. Playwright runs with `colorScheme: 'light'`.

## Surface 2: shared UI library, `web/src/components/ui/`

**Who, where, job.** Builders of every later chunk use it, for every user on every device. Its job: one typed component per design-system component, so screens never hand-write `wl-` markup.

The per-component specs follow. "Tokens" lists the tokens each component uses through its bundle class. "Copy" is final.

### Button, ButtonLink, IconButton, Kbd

- **Classes:**
  - `wl-btn wl-btn--{primary|secondary|ghost|danger}`, plus `wl-btn--sm` for the sm size.
  - `block` adds `w-full h-12 md:w-auto md:h-10`.
  - `ButtonLink` has the same classes on `next/link`.
  - `IconButton` is `wl-iconbtn` plus `wl-iconbtn--ok|--no`, with an `aria-label` that the type requires. It also gets `title` set to the same text, so mouse users can see the shortcut.
  - `Kbd` is `wl-kbd`.
- **Tokens:** `pitch`/`on-pitch` (primary); `surface-raised`, `line-strong`, `ink` and `surface-sunken` on hover (secondary); `pitch` and `pitch-soft` on hover (ghost); `danger` (danger); `radius-md`; `space-2`, `space-3` and `space-4`.
- **States:**
  - Default.
  - Hover: as the bundle defines it.
  - Focus: global ring.
  - Disabled: native `disabled`, which the bundle shows at .45 opacity. `ButtonLink` has no disabled state; render a disabled `Button` instead.
  - Pending: not part of D01. Callers disable the button.
- **Long content:** labels are verb-first, at most 4 words, and never wrap. A block button wraps its label if it must, because block buttons have no fixed width.
- **Screen readers:** the icon is `aria-hidden`. Kbd text is read as part of the label ("Confirm Y").

### StatusChip, EventStatusChip, MatchStatusChip

- **Classes:** `wl-chip wl-chip--{tone}`, an icon (required), then the word.
- **Tokens:** `pitch` on `pitch-soft` (ok), `warning` on `warning-soft`, `danger` on `danger-soft`, `ink-muted` on `surface-sunken` (neutral), `on-floodlight` on `floodlight` (new), `radius-sm`, `space-1`, `space-2`.

| State | Tone | Icon | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| confirmed | ok | Check | Confirmed |
| auto_accepted | ok | CheckCheck | Auto-accepted |
| pending_review | warn | TriangleAlert | Pending review |
| rejected | danger | X | Rejected |
| manual | ok | Plus | Manual |
| draft | neutral | CircleDashed | Draft |
| uploading | neutral | Upload | Uploading |
| processing | neutral | LoaderCircle (static, no spin) | Processing |
| awaiting_review | warn | Clock | Awaiting review |
| in_review | neutral | Eye | In review |
| published | ok | Check | Published |
| failed | danger | CircleAlert | Failed |
| (base) new | new | CircleDot | New |

- **Rules:** chips are never interactive. Use the `new` tone at most once per list. The CSS uppercases the label, so write it in sentence case in source. Chips do not wrap (`nowrap`); state words are at most 2 words.

### TeamMarker

- **Markup:** `<span class="wl-team wl-team--{side}">`, then `<span class="wl-team__mark" aria-hidden="true">H|A</span>`, then `<span class="sr-only">Home side: |Away side: </span>`, then the name.
- "Side" rather than "team", because the name can be a player ("Home side: #7 Thabo Nkosi").
- **Tokens:** `home` fill with `surface-raised` letter (home); `away` 2px outline and letter (away); `radius-sm`; `space-2`.
- **Long content:** the name sits in a `min-w-0 truncate` span when the parent limits its width. The full text stays in the DOM. `className` passes through, for example `font-medium` in event rows to match the preview.

### ConfidenceMeter

- **Markup:**
  - `wl-conf`, plus `wl-conf--low` when `score < threshold`.
  - The track is `aria-hidden`, and the fill width is the inline `${Math.round(score*100)}%`.
  - Then `<span class="sr-only">Confidence </span>{score.toFixed(2)}`.
  - With `detail` and low, the visible text " below threshold" follows.
  - Low without `detail` gets sr-only ", under auto-accept threshold". The low state is then never carried by colour alone for screen-reader users, and the visible words stay a detail-view rule as the README says. This string differs on purpose from the "below threshold" that the tests check.
- **Tokens:** `pitch` (at or above), `warning` (below), `surface-sunken` track with `line` border, `radius-pill`, `data` style.
- **Edge cases:** clamp the score to 0 to 1 before display. Score equal to the threshold is not low.
- **Never** use it on public profiles.

### ConsentBadge

| State | Tone | Icon | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| scout_visible | ok | ShieldCheck | Scout-visible |
| club_only | neutral | Shield | Club only |
| requested | warn | Hourglass | Requested |
| withdrawn | danger | ShieldOff | Withdrawn |
| none | neutral | none | No consent |

- **Rule:** never render the badge for scouts. Callers pass `consent` only in club views.

### ExpiryBanner, ExpiryLabel

- **Levels:**
  - More than 72h left: render nothing.
  - 72h down to 24h: `wl-banner`, `role="status"`, icon `Clock`.
  - Under 24h, or already past: `wl-banner wl-banner--danger`, `role="alert"`, icon `TriangleAlert`.
- **Copy:** the bold lead is "**Footage deleted in {timeLeft}.**" and `children` follows with the consequence.
  - `formatTimeLeft` floors, so it never overstates the time left: "3 days", "2 days", "1 day", "23 hours", "1 hour", "under 1 hour".
  - At or past expiry, the lead is "**Footage is due for deletion now.**" and `ExpiryLabel` reads "Due now".
- **Deletion date:** `formatDeletionDate` uses `en-ZA` with `timeZone: 'Africa/Johannesburg'` and builds the string from `formatToParts`. Plain `format()` gives "Friday, 24 Oct" with a comma; the required output is "Friday 24 Oct".
- **Children copy for callers:**
  - Warning, review workspace or match page: "Review this match before {date} to add missed events. Stats you confirm are kept."
  - Danger, unclaimed: "This match has no reviewer yet. Claim it now or it will publish with auto-accepted events only."
- **ExpiryLabel:** `wl-chip wl-chip--warn|--danger`, `Clock`, then `<span class="sr-only">Footage deleted in </span>` and the time left. Above 72h it renders nothing.
- **Tokens:** `warning`, `warning-soft`, `danger`, `danger-soft`, `ink`, `radius-md`, `space-3`, `space-4`.
- **Long content:** the body text wraps. The icon stays top-aligned (bundle).

### StatTile

- **Markup:**
  - `wl-card wl-stat` as a `next/link` when `href` is set, otherwise a `div`.
  - `wl-stat__label`, then `wl-stat__value` with an optional `wl-stat__unit`, then `wl-stat__sample`.
  - The linked tile adds `hover:border-line-strong transition-colors` and keeps the global focus ring.
- **Sample copy:**
  - 3 or more matches: "Based on N matches · M min". Leave out "· M min" when no minutes are passed.
  - Under 3 matches: add `wl-stat__sample--small` and write "Small sample · N matches" or "Small sample · 1 match" (no minutes).
  - The value always shows.
- **Edge cases:**
  - At 0 matches, render nothing. A stat with no traceable events is never shown.
  - Never colour or animate the value.
  - A long unit wraps under the number.
- **Tokens:** `surface-raised`, `line`, `radius-md`, `space-4`, `ink`, `ink-muted`, `warning` (small sample), `stat-xl` metrics.

### PlayerCard, PlayerCardMenu

- **Markup:** `<article class="wl-card wl-player relative">`, a 3-column grid.
  1. `wl-avatar`, `aria-hidden`, holding `initials(name)`: the first letter of the first and last words, uppercase.
  2. The text column:
     - `wl-player__name` holding the stretched link `wl-player__link` (`after:absolute after:inset-0`);
     - `wl-player__meta`;
     - the ConsentBadge (club views only) at `mt-2`.
  3. `PlayerCardMenu`, `self-start relative z-10`.
  4. `wl-player__stats`, full width, up to 4 stats. Leave the strip out when there are no stats.
- **Placement change from the preview:** the badge sits under the meta line, not in column 3. At 375px a column 3 holding badge and menu would leave the name about 80px. The README asks for "next to the name", and this layout keeps that.
- **Focus:** plain CSS in the Additions block: `.wl-player:has(.wl-player__link:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px }` and `.wl-player__link:focus-visible { outline: none }`. The ring then draws around the whole card, which is what the link covers. (A Tailwind `has-[.wl-player__link…]` class does not work: Tailwind turns `_` into spaces in arbitrary values. The link's own ring would be clipped by the name's `line-clamp-2`.) `gallery.spec.ts` checks the card's computed outline after Tab. Hover: `hover:border-line-strong`, 150ms.
- **Meta copy:** "{position} · {ageGroup} · {Left foot|Right foot|Both feet} · {club}". With no current club, the last part is "Former club: {name}", or "No current club" when there is no former club either. The meta line is already in `ink-muted`.
- **Long content:** the name is clamped to 2 lines (`line-clamp-2`), and the meta wraps. Stats wrap onto a second line, with a `space-3` row gap.
- **Menu trigger:** default `IconButton`, icon `Ellipsis`, `aria-label="More actions for {name}"`, `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`.
- **Menu:** `<div role="menu" class="wl-menu">` holding `<a role="menuitem" class="wl-menu__item">`:
  - **View profile** (icon `User`);
  - **Add to shortlist** (icon `Star`), only when `onAddToShortlist` or `shortlistHref` is set.
- **Menu keyboard:**
  - Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger opens the menu and focuses the first item.
  - ArrowUp and ArrowDown move between items and wrap around. Home and End jump to the first and last item.
  - Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.
  - Tab closes it and moves on.
  - A click outside closes it.
- **Menu tokens:** `surface-raised`, `line`, `radius-md`, `shadow-pop`, `surface-sunken` (item hover and focus), `radius-sm`.

### ReviewEventRow

- **Markup:** `<li class="wl-event" aria-current="true"?>`, then `wl-event__time` (`data` style), then `wl-event__what` holding:
  - `wl-event__type`;
  - `wl-event__who`: TeamMarker (`font-medium`) with "#7 Thabo Nkosi" or "Unlinked track 22", then " · {note}" when set.
- **Pending:** ConfidenceMeter, then a `wl-row` of three IconButtons: ok `Check` "Confirm (Y)", default `Pencil` "Edit (E)", no `X` "Reject (N)".
- **Handled:** EventStatusChip, then an empty `<span aria-hidden="true">`. The meter is dropped, as in the preview.
- **Current row:** `aria-current="true"` gives a `pitch-soft` fill and a 3px `pitch` inset bar (bundle). Only one row is current.
- **Phone:** stacked as in the Additions block. The full-width 48px action bar under the video belongs to C11.
- **Long content:** the type and the who line wrap inside column 2. The time never wraps.
- **Keyboard:** each pending row has three tab stops. J, K, Y, E and N handling is C11's job.
- **Tokens:** `surface-raised`, `line`, `pitch-soft`, `pitch`, `ink-muted`, `line-strong`, `danger`, `radius-md`, `space-2`, `space-3`.

### PitchHeatmap, AveragePositionMap

- **Markup:**
  - `svg.wl-pitch`, viewBox `-4 -4 113 76`, `role="img"`, `aria-label={label}`.
  - A turf rect, then the zone rects `h1` to `h5` at `opacity=".85"`. Only zones with a share above 0 get a rect. `heatLevel = ceil(share / max × 5)`.
  - The chalk markings, exactly as in `preview.html`.
- **Legend** (`wl-legend`, always visible): "Less time", then 5 `aria-hidden` swatches (`var(--heat-1..5)`), then "More time · attacking left to right · {N} matches" ("1 match" for one).
- **Small sample** (under 3 matches): the tail reads "· Small sample · 2 matches" in a `text-warning` span.
- **Empty** (every share is 0, or 0 matches): turf and chalk only, with no zones. The legend is replaced by `caption text-ink-muted` **No position data yet.**, and the aria-label becomes "Pitch: no position data yet".
- **AveragePositionMap:**
  - Same pitch and markings.
  - Per player, a circle with r 1.4 units (about 10px at 420px wide), class `dot-home` or `dot-away`.
  - A `dot-label` text at x + 2 that reads "H7" or "A9".
  - Under the pitch, a `wl-row gap-6 mt-2` key of two TeamMarkers.
  - With no players: the empty pitch, plus **No position data yet.**
- **Tokens:** `turf`, `chalk`, `heat-1` to `heat-5`, `home`, `away`, `ink-muted`, `warning`, `space-2`.

### Cover

- **Markup:**
  - `div.wl-cover`;
  - `div.wl-cover__art` (`aria-hidden`) holding the preview SVG, unchanged: viewBox `0 0 480 288`, the same rects, lines and circles. Classes are scoped under `.wl-cover__art`, and corners come from `.blk` and `.sm` (`rx: var(--radius-*)`);
  - `div.wl-cover__words`, holding `{titleAs}.wl-cover__name` and `p.wl-cover__tag`.
- **Copy:** "Wideline" / "Every match filmed. Every player findable."
- **Widths:** see the gallery table. The art shows from 1024px.

---

## Surface 3: theme mechanism

**Who, where, job.** Every user, on every device. The job: every screen follows the system light or dark setting. The CV Lab now, and the review workspace in C11, are always dark.

- **`<html data-theme>`:**
  - `ThemeScript` is an inline script in `<head>`, before first paint. It sets `dark` or `light` from `matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')` and updates it on `change`.
  - `<html>` has `suppressHydrationWarning`.
  - Without JS, the `prefers-color-scheme` block already in `tokens.css` applies.
- **`color-scheme`:** `globals.css` maps `[data-theme="light"]` to `light` and `[data-theme="dark"]` to `dark`, so scrollbars and native inputs match. A `ThemeScope` subtree gets the right `color-scheme` from the same rule.
- **Forced dark:**
  - `ThemeScope theme="dark"` renders `<div data-theme="dark" class="bg-surface text-ink …">` on the server, so it never flashes.
  - Lab layout: `<ThemeScope theme="dark" className="min-h-screen lg:flex">`.
  - C11 wraps the review workspace the same way.
  - Known edge: on iOS overscroll, the `<html>` background (system theme) can show at the very top or bottom of a forced-dark page. This is accepted for D01.
- **States:**
  - System light: light.
  - System dark: dark.
  - System setting changes while open: the attribute updates live, with no reload.
  - Forced scope: ignores the system setting.
  - No JS: the CSS media query follows the system setting.
- **No toggle and no copy.** D01 has no user theme switch and stores nothing.
- **Accessibility:** both themes meet the token contrast pairs (4.5:1 text, 3:1 `line-strong` and `focus`). Nothing in the theme mechanism is focusable.
